text.tspan: Limits and deadlines: where each one applies
Override any value: AGENT_HARNESS_SET__SECTION__KEY=value. Workers check deadlines at every reconcile; without workers run `agent-harness expire`.

g.text: From a chat front end or any API client.
A token bucket per API key; over it -> 429 with Retry-After.
The tenant's and the end user's daily runs, tokens, cost, and concurrency, in one transaction.
Its budget is capped to what the quotas granted.
Budgets and the tenant's and user's consumption are re-checked before each model call.
Replies are capped by max_tokens; adapter retries show up as provider_attempts.
Step 8 of 14 · Too many tool calls?
A runaway reply with too many calls is refused before any runs.
Each call gets a refusal; the model is asked again.
Identical repeated calls are refused too.
Step 11 of 14 · Waiting for a person
An approval or an ask_user question pauses the run.
After a deny, a worker resumes the run at the next step.
